title: access.grants.list: output
description: access-grants/1 (fabric-agent-contract DEC-0187 at commit 320c7ab9, vendored in fabric/access-grants/, whose schema this repeats with this file's own $id): the provider keys this engine's OpenRouter door issued, each with its holder by service key when that is measured, else unresolved; the provider account it opens; its ceiling and today's spend (null when unknown); when it was issued and revoked. No key value, prefix, hash or digits of one, and no person's name or address. Semantic rule FAC-SEM-185.

issuer.description: The service answering: the product that issued every grant listed (AG-1).

doors.description: The operations behind the issuing product's agent surface that issue and revoke a grant, each also declared as a dashboard action with gate relayed (AG-6). Absent: the product offers neither door to agents.

issue.description: The product's own issue operation; its input is the product's own, read from its search (DEC-0180 CM-3). Its answer never carries a key value.

nextCursor.description: Present when more grants match the input: pass it as listInput.cursor.

degraded.description: What the product could not read for this answer (a store, the spend counter). Absent or empty: the answer is whole.

serviceKey.description: A service key <id>.<instance> (service.md, Descriptor), the name Fabric Dashboards and the estate know an agent by.

opaqueRef.description: An opaque reference the product keeps (a member id, a machine id, a grant or audit record): never a name, an email address, a session id or a secret (DL-22). It admits no @ and no space.

id.description: Stable across answers and unique in one (FAC-SEM-185); the revoke door names it.

subject.description: What the grant opens. Absent: the issuing service itself (AG-3).

scopes.description: The product's own scope names, as it enforces them; empty when the grant has no scopes of its own (the whole subject).

limitUsd.description: The grant's own ceiling in USD; null: no ceiling. Absent: the product does not meter money on this grant (AG-4).

limitPeriod.description: The window of limitUsd: the current UTC day, ISO week or month (DEC-0183 SL-1), or the grant's whole life. Present exactly when limitUsd is a number (FAC-SEM-185).

spentDayUsd.description: Spent on this grant in the UTC day of generatedAt; null: unknown, never 0 for unknown. Absent: not metered.

expiresAt.description: When the grant stops admitting; after issued.at (FAC-SEM-185).

revoked.description: Present once the grant was revoked; a revoked grant is never admitted again (a new grant is a new id).

label.description: The product's own earlier label, shown as written until the product maps it to a holder (AG-2); a host never guesses an agent from it.

provider.description: The provider whose account the grant opens (openrouter, anthropic, cloudflare).

by.description: Whose decision: the operator (at the dashboard, or relayed by an agent with a decision, AP-2), another person of the context (an organization's administrator), an agent on its own account, or the service itself (a default, its configuration, an exposure it found).

via.description: The door: a person at the dashboard, an agent's call, the configuration, or the service's own check.

agent.description: The agent that made the call, present exactly when via is agent (FAC-SEM-185).

ref.description: An opaque reference to the decision or the audit record; for by person, the person's opaque reference.

listInput.description: The input of access.grants.list: every member optional; absent filters answer every grant the caller may read.

subject.description: Only grants that open this agent (a grant without subject opens the issuer).

includeRevoked.description: true: revoked and expired grants too. Absent or false: only those that admit now.

repeated.description: true when the idempotency key answered an earlier call, or the grant was already revoked (its first revocation is answered).
